description.value: Five Guys is a well-known burger chain founded in 1986 in Arlington, Virginia, now with nearly 1,700 locations worldwide, including this Richmond outpost in a shopping centre on Steveston Highway. The brand is known for hand-formed fresh burgers cooked well done, fresh-cut fries in peanut oil, and a no-freezer policy. A touring cyclist looking for a substantial, customizable meal in Richmond's south end would find this a reliable if chain-style option.
